title: 第318章 师兄哪吒14姐姐不哭我很快就会回来了第317章 师兄哪吒13我变成哪吒之后你别走好吗
slug: 西游恶人攻略录哪吒总骗我亲他
lines: 江盼张了张嘴，想说些什么，眼泪却不争气地先掉了下来。
灵珠子伸出透明的小手，想要帮她擦眼泪。
手指穿过她的脸颊，什么也没碰到。
他微微一怔，转瞬弯起眉眼，笑得温柔纯粹，一如往昔那般。
“姐姐不哭。
我很快就回来了。”
“到时候，你要记得我。”
他凑上前，在她脸颊上落下一记轻吻。
这一次，嘴唇穿过了皮肤，没有温度，没有触感。
但他还是认认真真地亲了一下。
亲完，他没有后退，而是就那样贴着她的脸颊，用只有她能听见的声音，轻轻说了一句：
“等我。”
话音落下，灵珠子的神魂骤然绽放出耀眼的金光。
魔气被金光驱散，殷夫人周身的黑雾如潮水般褪去，她的脸色渐渐恢复红润，呼吸也变得平稳。
而灵珠子的身影，越来越淡，越来越淡——
他的目光，在消散前的最后一刻，依然落在江盼身上。
没有看太乙。
没有看殷夫人。
没有看任何人。
只有她。
从头到尾，只有她。
“灵珠子！”
太乙扑过去，却只抓住一团空气。
金光散去，半空中空空荡荡。
那个软糯乖巧的小团子，那个会奶声奶气喊“师父”
的小家伙，那个夜里非要赖在她床上不肯走的小小人儿——
消失了。
房间里只剩下殷夫人平稳的呼吸声，和李靖低低的啜泣。
江盼站在原地，眼泪止不住地往下掉。
她甚至不知道自己为什么哭。
不过是一个任务目标，不过是系统分配给她攻略的对象，不过是一个迟早会消失的前世神魂——
可是她想起他第一次牵她的手，耳朵尖红红的，声音小得像蚊子叫：“姐姐，我可以牵你的手吗？”
想起他深夜抱着枕头来敲门，理直气壮地说“我认姐姐”
想起他坐在三轮车车斗里，笑得小丸子乱晃，风把他的笑声吹散在乾元山的风里。
想起他踮起脚尖，亲她的脸颊。
一次偷偷摸摸，一次明目张胆。
“姐姐不哭。
content_en:
Jiang Pan opened his mouth and wanted to say something, but tears fell down first.
Lingzhuzi stretched out her transparent little hand, trying to wipe her tears.
His fingers crossed her cheek and touched nothing.
He was startled for a moment, then raised his eyebrows and smiled gently and purely, just like before.
"Sister, don't cry.
I'll be back soon. "
"When the time comes, you must remember me."
He leaned forward and placed a soft kiss on her cheek.
This time, the lips passed through the skin, without warmth or touch.
But he still kissed her seriously.
After the kiss, he did not step back. Instead, he pressed his cheek against hers and said softly in a voice that only she could hear:
"Wait for me."
As soon as the words fell, Ling Zhuzi's soul suddenly burst into dazzling golden light.
The evil spirit was dispersed by the golden light, and the black mist around Mrs. Yin faded away like a tide. Her face gradually returned to rosy, and her breathing became steady.
And the figure of Lingzhu is getting lighter and lighter -
His eyes, at the last moment before dissipating, still fell on Jiang Pan.
Didn't look at Taiyi.
He didn’t look at Mrs. Yin.
Not looking at anyone.
Only her.
From beginning to end, it was just her.
"Spirit beads!"
Taiyi rushed over, but only caught a ball of air.
The golden light dissipated, leaving the air empty.
That soft and cute little dumpling, the one who calls out "Master" in a milky voice
The little guy, the little one who insists on staying on her bed at night and refuses to leave——
Gone.
The only sounds left in the room were Mrs. Yin's steady breathing and Li Jing's low sobs.
Jiang Pan stood there, tears falling uncontrollably.
She didn't even know why she was crying.
It’s just a mission target, just a target assigned to her by the system to conquer, just a soul from her past life that will disappear sooner or later——
But she remembered the first time he held her hand. The tips of her ears were red, and her voice was as low as a mosquito's cry: "Sister, can I hold your hand?"
I remember him knocking on the door late at night with a pillow in his arms and confidently saying "I recognize my sister"
I remembered him sitting in the carriage of a tricycle, laughing so hard that his little balls were swaying, and the wind blew his laughter away in the wind of Qianyuan Mountain.
Thinking of him standing on tiptoes and kissing her cheek.
Once sneakily, once blatantly.
"Sister, don't cry.
title_en: Chapter 318 Senior Brother Nezha 14 Sister, if you don’t cry, I will be back soon Chapter 317 Senior Brother Nezha 13 Please don’t leave after I become Nezha, okay?
